# Home
Re-Elect Campbell Mayor
DAN FURTADO
Thank you for visiting my website! I am honored to serve the entire Campbell community by representing District 3 residents. As your Mayor, I work to maintain our local quality of life by:
Protecting our fire protection/emergency medical services
Maintaining 911 public safety response times
Keeping our parks safe and litter-free
Supporting Campbell’s small business community
Ensuring your views are reflected in all City decision-making
Together, let’s maintain Campbell’s small town character, quality of life, and core services you expect and deserve. If I can provide constituent assistance to you or your family, please contact me at dan@danfurtado.com.
Mayor Dan Furtado
About Campbell Mayor
DAN FURTADO
Mayor and former Vice Mayor/Councilmember Dr. Dan Furtado is a native of Campbell, former Civic Improvement Commissioner and Citizen of the Year.
A military veteran, educator and health specialist, Dr. Furtado has a lifetime of community service and leadership, serving two years active duty with the U.S. Army, and retiring as Colonel with 40 years of service in the Army Reserve.
Dr. Furtado previously taught at Cal State Monterey Bay and Stanford University School of Medicine, where he also served as Associate Director of the Primary Care Associate Program in the Division of Family & Community Medicine. He is a former Board Member and President of the Santa Clara County Chapter of the American Heart Association.
He received his BA in Chemistry and Biology at San José State University, and his Doctor of Pharmacy Degree from the University of California, San Francisco. Dr. Furtado also holds a Master of Public Administration degree from the University of San Francisco and is a Life Fellow of the American College of Healthcare Executives.
Leadership for Campbell
Selected Public & Community Leadership/Advocacy:
- California Army Reserve Ambassador
- Member, US Conference of Mayors
- Board Member, National League of Cities & League of California Cities
- Executive Board Member, Association of Bay Area Governments
- County Emergency Preparedness Council
- County Library Joint Powers
- County Housing Trust Board
- County Flood Control Advisory Committee
Selected 2026 Committee Assignments & Appointments
- Vice Chair, Silicon Valley Regional Interoperability Authority (SVRIA)
- US Mayors Water Council
- West Valley Sanitation District
- Valley Transportation Authority Policy Advisory Committee
- Campbell City Council Economic Development Subcommittee
- Campbell City Council Finance Subcommittee
Mayor Furtado representing Campbell at the 2026 US Conference of Mayors, shown with Philadelphia Mayor Cherelle Parker.
Mayor Furtado with Campbell UHSD School Boardmember Jason Baker.
Priorities
As a Campbell native, nothing is more important to me than protecting our unique small town character, supporting our small businesses and maintaining our family-friendly quality of life. As your Mayor, I work to address what I hear from you – the residents I serve – as being your needs and concerns:
Quality of Life: I’ll continue to protect our safety, properly maintain our streets/sidewalks, and preserve our libraries, parks, and recreation centers. These services make Campbell a safe, beautiful, and vibrant community.
Public Safety: Police and fire protection is my highest priority, including crime investigation, and maintaining 911 response times, keeping Campbell a safe place to live, run a business, and raise a family.
Children/Youth: In today’s digital age, it is more important than ever to give our Campbell youth opportunities for sports and recreation. Our many playgrounds, parks, and programs keep kids active and learning, especially after school and in the summertime.
